sections.heading: Questions? We’ve Got Answers.
sections.subheading: Everything small business owners ask us before getting started.

items.question: Do I need developers or IT to set this up?
items.answer: Not at all. Pluto connects to your existing tools — email, CRM, project management, Slack — in minutes. No code, no developers, no IT tickets. If you can send a message, you can use Pluto.

items.question: How is Pluto different from ChatGPT or other AI tools?
items.answer: ChatGPT answers questions. Pluto takes action. It connects directly to your tools, follows up with real people, pulls real data, and completes real workflows — it doesn’t just give you suggestions and leave you to do the work.

items.question: Is my business data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Your data stays yours — always. Pluto runs in a secure cloud environment with enterprise-grade encryption. It does not train on your data and does not share information between clients. Built for businesses that handle sensitive operations.

items.question: What does it actually cost?
items.answer: Pluto starts at $49/month for the Starter plan — deployment, maintenance, tool connectors, and the full skills library included. Compare that to a $55K/year operations hire. Pro plan at $299/month adds AI tokens, all connectors, and priority support.

items.question: What kinds of tasks can Pluto handle?
items.answer: Client follow-ups, report generation, data entry, vendor communications, onboarding workflows, scheduling, CRM updates, and much more. If it’s repetitive and lives in your digital tools, Pluto can handle it.
